# plot_maxima_from_grid { #mofography.threejs_viz.plot_maxima_from_grid }

<span class="mg-tag mg-tag-recommended">go-to</span> Maxima traces from dgrid and coordinate arrays without full seg.

```python
threejs_viz.plot_maxima_from_grid(
    dgrid,
    maxima,
    ase_atoms,
    *,
    regions=None,
    name='Maxima',
    cscale=None,
    hide_periodic=False,
    trace_id=None,
    maxima_info=None,
    maxima_pbc=None,
    maxima_pbc_dict=None,
    connections=None,
    **kwargs,
)
```

Build Three.js maxima traces from dgrid, maxima arrays, and optional regions.
